description: COSMO15 is the first (13-17 GHz) radiometer of the COSMOSOMAS circular-scanning experiment at Teide Observatory, mapping CMB anisotropies and diffuse Galactic foregrounds.
facility_description: Teide Observatory (Observatorio del Teide) is an astronomical observatory located on Mount Teide in Tenerife, Canary Islands, operated by the Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias (IAC).
notes: Radio total-power channels; channel edges and receiver details were not verified against Gallegos et al. (2001).
